I choose: Four days in the office

One reason for this choice is that the in-office days can enhance team collaboration and communication, which can lead to better problem-solving and innovation. While remote work can be highly productive, the physical presence in the office can foster a stronger sense of community and facilitate spontaneous interactions that are crucial for certain types of projects and team dynamics.

I choose: Fully remote

One reason for this choice is that numerous studies and real-world examples, such as the 2026 Stanford study of 1,600 engineers, have shown that remote work can maintain high levels of productivity and job satisfaction without the need for in-office days. This model often leads to reduced commute times, increased flexibility, and potentially lower overhead costs, all of which can contribute to sustained high performance.
